evidence.note: Missing-parent and missing-entry writers always pair exists false with contents none; the exists-true writer at 713 is the only path that may carry Some(contents).
Non-file entries return exists true with contents none; exists false with Some(contents) is never constructed.

evidence.note: tryAdmitSelf writes originBusy true only with admitted none; the success arm at 1600-1607 writes admitted some only with originBusy false.
tryPromoteTicket copies originBusy only on the admitted-none arm and forces originBusy false when admitted is Some; combined-true is never a third outcome.

notes: Attempt outcome origin-busy | rejected | admitted. originBusy partitions the none case rather than restating admitted presence.

evidence.note: Self-blocked and attempt-failed arms write admitted none with a possibly-true originBusy; the admitted arm at 1757 forces originBusy false.
The wait loop returns on Some(admitted) and otherwise stamps blockedOnOriginAtMillis from originBusy; combined-true is not a handled tick.
